correctness.rationale: The edge-plane chord calculation gives an exact all-direction formula. Jensen yields M≥R0, the rational H is monotone for the full domain, and the chord bound for sqrt(1+c²) gives an explicit strictly positive transverse perimeter gap. The b=1 wall is checked separately. The remaining one-parameter function is strictly convex: exact second derivatives and an explicit interval split prove \(F''(b)>0\), with opposite endpoint derivative signs giving the unique root and equality set. The standalone checker confirms the critical identities and independently reconstructs 2400 central section polygons; finite checks do not substitute for the analytic continuum proof.

value.rationale: Central-section perimeter is a canonical metric invariant of a classical Archimedean solid. The full exact optimizer lies at a non-symmetry-axis tilt, contrary to the central section-area extrema, and the global transverse lower bound explains rigidly why all normals off a coordinate plane are worse. Complete normal-orbit and numerical critical-point classification is a structurally meaningful exact optimization theorem, not an isolated special-case calculation or a mere reparametrization.
